import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-74.05, 40.57], [-73.85, 40.57], 
    [-73.85, 40.75], [-74.05, 40.75], 
    [-74.05, 40.57]
]])

# Function to process NO2 data for a given year
def get_no2_mean(year):
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
        .filterDate(f'{year}-10-01', f'{year}-10-24') \
        .filterBounds(brooklyn) \
        .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
    
    size = collection.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        return None, 0, size
    
    # Calculate mean image and get stats
    mean_img = collection.mean()
    stats = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=brooklyn,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    no2_mean = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
    pixel_count = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count', 0)
    
    return no2_mean, pixel_count, size

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
years = [2018, 2019, 2021]
results = {}

for year in years:
    no2_mean, pixel_count, collection_size = get_no2_mean(year)
    results[year] = {
        'mean': no2_mean,
        'pixels': pixel_count,
        'size': collection_size
    }
    print(f"{year}: Images={collection_size}, Mean={no2_mean:.4f}, Pixels={pixel_count}")

# 3. Check for data issues
for year in years:
    if results[year]['size'] == 0:
        print(f"No data for {year}")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    elif results[year]['pixels'] == 0:
        print(f"No valid pixels for {year}")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    elif results[year]['mean'] is None or results[year]['mean'] < 0:
        print(f"Invalid calculation for {year}")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()

# 4. Final comparison
no2_2021 = results[2021]['mean']
no2_2019 = results[2019]['mean']
no2_2018 = results[2018]['mean']

print(f"Comparison: 2021={no2_2021:.4f}, 2019={no2_2019:.4f}, 2018={no2_2018:.4f}")

if no2_2021 < no2_2019 and no2_2021 < no2_2018:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
